sources.title: [2112.03857] Grounded Language-Image Pre-training - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: This paper presents a grounded language-image pre-training (GLIP) model for learning object-level, language-aware, and semantic-rich visual representations. GLIP unifies object detection and phrase grounding for pre-training. sources.title: [2311.17593] LanGWM: Language Grounded World Model - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Specifically, we focus on learning language-grounded visual features to enhance the world model learning, a model-based reinforcement learning technique. To enforce our hypothesis explicitly, we mask out the bounding boxes of a few objects in the image observation and provide the text prompt as descriptions for these masked objects.

sources.title: Large language model - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: A large language model (LLM) is an AI model (typically a neural network) trained on a vast amount of text for natural language processing tasks, especially language generation.
